_comment: Copy to <repo>/brigade.config.json and commit it. Settings everyone working in this repo should get. Overrides the global layer; a person's own .brigade/config.local.json still wins over this.
_plannerModel_comment: Model the Planner session should be on for this repo. A model alias or full id (fable | opus | sonnet | haiku | claude-...), NOT an agent type. null = take the tier's planning row from TIERS.md. The session-model handshake at dish intake compares against this.

policy._comment: This repo has wide blast radius, so the plan always gets an adversarial check.

append: Database work goes through the repository layer; never write raw SQL in a handler.
